Exact package verification checks the products, spectral radicals, universal symmetric sample, and symbolic trace formula. All-dimensional invariance is analytical, not inferred from enumeration. Nonlinear extinction follows coordinatewise comparison; positive orbit follows monotone sub/supersolution iteration. Threshold equality is not addressed.

value.rationale: An exact qualitative threshold separation, not a routine numerical improvement: for a fixed collection of seasonal exposure matrices and durations, the permitted reciprocal/directed structure determines a sharp universal minimum number of phases needed for chronological scheduling to flip disease-free invasion, with rigorous two-group constructions yielding extinction versus positive periodic persistence. The invariant result holds in arbitrary group dimension and does not assume commutation. This clarifies when temporal order can and cannot alter epidemic control thresholds; individual standard matrix identities are the tools, while the sharp epidemiological phase classification and paired crossing examples form the motivated result.
